evidence.redaction: Only frozen synthetic Git objects, declared name-only diff, two declared audit messages, and cleaned temporary synthetic replays; no product source, owner input, secrets, network, database, UAT, production, Docker, or deployment data.

risks.impact: JSON Schema alone cannot express cross-array agent_id uniqueness or product_writer_agent_id equality, and R1.5 still has no OS-level identity or runtime authority.
risks.trigger: A caller bypasses the required standard-library Task Packet validator or treats this synthetic gate as product, UAT, production, deployment, or R2 authorization.
risks.mitigation: Require both Task Packet Schema and validate_task_packet before execution, preserve NO_RUNTIME_AUTHORITY and all denied capabilities, and require new owner authorization for later runtime work.
risks.residual_risk: Acceptable for this synthetic docs/test MVP only; it is not a runtime security boundary.

recommendation.reason: All 16 declared artifact digests and the canonical Context Manifest digest matched. I ran 85 authorized test_native_mvp.py cases plus all 47 test_readonly_controller.py cases (132 PASS). Two native cases were excluded because their context-schema inventory and checked-in black-box fixture objects were not among the 16 authorized locators. Empty, RESULT_UNKNOWN, NOT_RUN, FAIL, reused-evidence, unreferenced-TEST_REPORT, and wrong/mismatched-exit claim-resolution attacks all failed closed in Schema and/or the authoritative validator. Duplicate-role, reviewer-write, profile, and visibility attacks failed in both layers; unassigned-writer and cross-role duplicate-agent attacks failed in the documented standard-library pre-execution layer. Authorized regressions for old-candidate PASS, veto, lease/revision, artifact/context digests, cross-role black-box evidence, RESULT_UNKNOWN recovery, and closure also passed. No attack bypassed the combined contract.
recommendation.next_action: Proceed to same-candidate QA and source-blind black-box gates; keep PHASE4-TASK03 frozen and do not access product, database, UAT/production, network, or deployment.
